phases.contract: Planning and documentation retain product decisions and independent surface boundaries.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Validate admission of phase consumers and immutable evidence file bindings.
phases.authority: Read-only validator rejects incomplete or stale evidence; grants no execution authority.
phases.persistence: Versioned JSON registry and independent feature ledger.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Sandboxed desktop renderer reaches bounded broker actions through preload.
phases.authority: Main-process contracts validate requests; renderer receives narrow APIs.
phases.persistence: Main-process settings store; native credential protection remains separately unverified.
phases.acceptanceGap: Stable broker contract only; changing main/preload integration, native execution and Windows acceptance remain unverified.

phases.contract: Workspace service and versioned persistence consume plan, settings and onboarding requests. Renderer integration remains under active implementation and is excluded from this source snapshot.
phases.authority: Controls invoke bounded workspace methods; plans do not execute builds.
phases.persistence: Versioned workspace store and serialized renderer preferences.
phases.acceptanceGap: Authored workspace persistence only. Active renderer changes have no admitted hash here; localization, GUI/runtime and Windows acceptance remain unverified.

phases.contract: Durable records, recovery snapshots, locks and accessibility must preserve user state.
phases.authority: Mutation ownership and explicit restore authorization must be enforced.
phases.persistence: Atomic versioned stores, recovery records and explicit cleanup.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Discover real sources and WSL/Docker runtimes and schedule owned project tasks.
phases.authority: Normal-user runtime adapters validate source consent, executable identity and ownership.
phases.persistence: Project revisions, runtime identity, durable queues and source locks.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Authoritative Kconfig reconciliation, package/overlay editing and builds consume actual source trees.
phases.authority: Typed Linux bridge serializes output mutations and preserves effective configuration.
phases.persistence: Source/config snapshots, requested/effective revisions and build records.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Real image conversion, VM lifecycle, reproducibility and deployment adapters preserve artifact provenance.
phases.authority: Reviewed typed adapters own exact resources; destination actions require bounded authority.
phases.persistence: Artifact hashes, guest identities, reproducibility manifests and transfer receipts.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Converter, Ollama, Minecraft and publication workflows use actual packaged tool consumers.
phases.authority: Tool-specific validated adapters enforce reviewed operations and credential references.
phases.persistence: Durable tool queues, checkpoints, catalog versions and recovery state.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Independent visitor features and authenticated paired companion actions use explicit capability states.
phases.authority: Scoped pairing, origin checks, replay protection and revocation bound broker access.
phases.persistence: Client state, paired identities, scoped grants and revocation records.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.

phases.contract: Windows packaging and release acceptance bind installers and native behavior to reviewed builds.
phases.authority: Build and publication remain separate; native acceptance requires actual host evidence.
phases.persistence: Installer hashes, dependency manifests, native acceptance and release receipts.
phases.acceptanceGap: Full feature, localization, runtime and native acceptance remain unverified; Windows tests deferred by owner.
